verdict.rationale: A third-party UI component library ecosystem is a fair question for a UI framework like React, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions any third-party pre-built component libraries. The cited items cover building your own components (react-docs-49), full-stack frameworks like Next.js (react-docs-4), React Native (react-docs-5), and tooling, none of which is a UI component library.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pick from a rich ecosystem of third-party pre-built UI component libraries for the framework
